name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. The text-to-speech API generated a valid MP3 audio file (output.mp3, 43,511 bytes, 44.1 kHz, 128 kbps, ~2.69 seconds) from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." using the George voice (JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb) and the eleven_v3 model.
deviations: The quickstart's `play(audio)` function requires MPV to be installed, which was not available in the sandbox. Instead of playing through speakers (impossible in a headless sandbox), I saved the returned audio stream to a file (`output.mp3`). This is a more verifiable outcome than audio playback and confirms the same API call succeeded. The exact quickstart code was also run (example_exact.py) and executed without errors, though it produced no file since `play()` silently handles the audio stream without MPV.

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural

friction.detail: The quickstart's `play(audio)` function requires MPV to be installed, which was not available in the sandbox.
